name: L-system grove
doc: Bracketed L-system trees (five grammars) grown by a turtle: a new tree every phrase, its depth set by how full the spectrum was before the phrase, growing with time and loudness; the spectral centroid (pitch content) opens the branching angle, bass sways it, each onset sends a glow up from the roots and flashes the blossoms at the tips, and on the phrase change the old tree fades and drops its blossoms.

palette.doc: stop 0 the sky and ground, low stops the trunk, high stops the twigs and blossoms

grammar.doc: rewrite rules; random = a new grammar per tree and phrase

bars.doc: phrase length in bars: a new tree grows each phrase

depth.doc: offset on the rewrite depth the spectrum picks

angle.doc: scale on the grammar's branching angle

pitch.doc: how far the spectral centroid opens the branches

flex.doc: how far a kick flexes the branches open

flash.doc: how bright onsets flash the blossoms and the glow up the tree
